title: Three things we
noticed about Flow School
Three things
we noticed
about Flow School
sections.kicker: Prepared for Flow School by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Flow School says something bold in one line and describes itself plainly in the next.
sections.keep: The photograph. A teacher mid-pose in a real room is the clearest proof of who this is for.

pins.quote: Own the hell out of your voice
pins.what: The small line above the headline is the only place the brand has a voice.
pins.why: The headline is a category label, so Flow School reads like any teacher training until someone notices the line above it.
pins.how: Let the bold line carry the headline and let the category sit underneath.
pins.label: Your eyebrow line
pins.cost: Teachers compare Flow School to other programs by format, not by attitude.

pins.quote: expand the craft of flow design
pins.what: The description explains the product in neutral terms.
pins.why: Nothing in it could not describe a dozen online yoga programs.
pins.how: Say what flow design means here and why only Flow School teaches it that way.
pins.label: Your description
pins.cost: The term that could be yours stays a phrase anyone can use.

pins.quote: You’re handing people the power of their own creative expression.
pins.what: The one testimonial on the page praises what teachers give their students.
pins.why: It says nothing about what Flow School gave the teacher, which is the reason to join.
pins.how: Choose a member quote that names the change in the teacher.
pins.label: Your testimonial
pins.cost: The proof shown is about someone else's students, not about you.

sections.body: It is 20 minutes with me. We go through this page together, on Flow School's own screens, and you leave knowing what to change first.
sections.note: A few short questions first, then you pick a time. You can also just reply to the email.

reference: Aesop, from another category. Its copy sounds like one person with firm opinions, and every surface keeps that voice.
